-def get_host() -> Optional[str]:

+"""Configuration utilities for host handling.
+
+The original implementation used ``Optional[str]`` as the return type for
+``get_host`` even though the function always returns a concrete string.  This
+caused static type checkers to complain when the result was passed to ``len``
+because ``len`` expects a ``Sized`` object, not ``None``.
+
+To retain the original runtime behaviour while satisfying the type checker we
+simply tighten the return type to ``str``.  The function body is unchanged – it
+still returns ``"localhost"`` – so the public API remains compatible.
+"""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+def get_host() -> str:
+    """Return the host name.
+
+    The function is deliberately simple for the purpose of the exercises; it
+    always returns the literal ``"localhost"``.
+    """
+    return "localhost"
